boundary.accesses: our own compiled kernel bytes with at most one spliced base-slot selector byte per case; one case per fresh process
boundary.native_encoding_claim: NONE beyond the splice-validated base-slot selector bytes

capture.between_runs_gate: run01 must be a complete closed raw tree (all 351 cases, consistent envelope, no STOP) and work absent or empty before run02 is created
capture.case_fault_policy: a faulted, hung, or killed case is a recorded result (status watchdog/proc_fail/proc_timeout) and is never retried in place; only 3 consecutive OS-level spawn failures stop the run
capture.cross_run_provenance_gate: run02 current Git revision and authored hashes must equal the closed run01 input record
capture.cross_run_repeat_gate: every case must have identical status in both runs, and probe_word must be identical whenever either run's value is zero or pattern-decodable (the deterministic classes); only garbage-class values may differ and those are reported as the observed determinism answer, not gate-required
capture.extra_keys_policy: Exact key-set equality for every record slot: a record carrying any key outside its frozen set fails, and a record missing any frozen key fails.
capture.failure_record: Pre-capture failures retain work/<run-id>/STOP.json and never create the raw tree (pre-capture repair authorized); post-capture, STOP.json is append-only and ends that run; never retry automatically
capture.identification_gate: the probe instruction of every spliced kernel is located pre-capture from our own compiled bytes (differential compilation for the census kernels, unique-instruction decode for the store/atomic kernels) and the identification is recorded in 02_build.json before any case runs
capture.selftest_gate: verify.py --selftest (runnable in every tree state, on synthetic roots only) must pass immediately before every capture; a capture whose verifier gates are unproven is not authorized
capture.smoke_gate: before the append-only raw tree is created, the freshly built harness must run one scratch case (c31_load_slot_1) into work/ (never promoted into raw/), and its stdout must parse as one complete JSON record with every contracted field present and a consistent shape; any payload-shape or truncation defect is a pre-capture STOP

compile.language_version: not pinned; default read back and recorded verbatim
compile.math_mode: not set (default); raw value read back and recorded verbatim

gate: A missing path, hash, schema field, timeout record, or gate-sequence proof fails the corresponding gate; nothing is promoted until verify.py --captured passes

geometry.fill_rule: word w of buffer k = P(k,w) = 0xC0DE0000 | (k<<8) | w, except the idxbuf binding whose word 0 is the frozen probe element index 5

hypotheses.H1_MEM15: a kernel reading through all 31 MSL buffer indices at once returns every distinguishable value correctly
hypotheses.H2_MEM16: census31 slot k holds buffer k for k=1..30 (probe returns P(k,5)); slot 0 does not hold buffer 0 and is characterized, not assumed
hypotheses.H3_MEM17_load: slots outside the populated set read 0x00000000 with no fault and no buffer change; 128..255 mirror their value-128 counterparts
hypotheses.H4_MEM17_store: a store through an unpopulated slot is discarded; through a populated slot it writes that slot's buffer
hypotheses.H5_MEM17_atomic: an exchange through an unpopulated selector returns 0 and writes nothing; through a populated selector it exchanges that buffer
hypotheses.H6_control: with only 4 buffers bound, slots 1..3 hold the same buffers as census31 and the other tested slots read zero

matrix.note: census31 covers every encoded slot value 0..255; census4 covers every MEM-16 boundary with 16-value context windows; capacity/store/atomic cover the MEM-15 direct method and the MEM-17 op classes

question: MEM-15/MEM-16/MEM-17 device-buffer base-slot census: capacity, alias/hole/reservation map over the encoded slot range, and unpopulated/out-of-range load/store/atomic behavior, for the compute stage
target: M4/G16G local host through public Metal only
